text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
—That was just like Inari-chan, wasn't it?
What a wonderful debut race♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Just watching it cheered me up.
It was a fantastic run—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh...
Hahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Bwaa-ha-ha-ha!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ain't this the best, though?!
This is the real thrill of an actual race, a true festival!
Man, I can't get enough of this shit!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This rush from just my debut race...!
What's gonna happen to me if I dive into an even bigger festival...?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Gaaaaah!
Get outta here, dammit all!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to greet Inari One
after her magnificent debut race――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss—!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Big Siiis!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Inari One.
I launched it off right and proper, and now I'm back!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this, Boss!
Even though the run's over, the heat in my body
ain't coolin' down one bit...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this, Sis!
Even though the run's over, the heat in my body
ain't coolin' down one bit...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
More... more, more, more!
I want an even hotter festival! I wanna run right now!
My heart is churning with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gaaaah! Hell yeah!
Next time, I'm gonna set off
an even bigger fireworks show than today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she just finished running, Inari One is overflowing with energy and motivation...!
In that case, why not just—
choice_data_list: Alright, time to train as soon as we get back!
Alright, let's train as soon as we get back!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh! As expected of Boss, you sure understand!
Let's turn this into today's review session
and have you keep me company the whole way through!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh! As expected of Big Sis, you sure understand!
Let's turn this into today's review session
and have you keep me company the whole way through!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "Now that that's settled, strike while the iron is hot! Let's get changed and head back to the academy!"
